statements.impact_statement: Boundary: the worker neither accepts nor extracts archives, and its runtime source does not import tarfile. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-11940 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.

Boundary: the worker neither accepts nor streams tar archives, and its runtime source does not import tarfile. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-11972 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.
Boundary: the JSON-only worker does not parse HTML or import html.parser. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15308 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.

Boundary: the vulnerable ProactorEventLoop implementation is Windows-only; this image is locked and tested as linux/amd64. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-3298 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any platform/package change.

Boundary: Starlette imports http.cookies only for request parsing, while the worker never accesses Request.cookies and no path updates/unpickles Morsel or calls BaseCookie.js_output. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-3644 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python/package/request-cookie path change.

Boundary: the worker accepts JSON plus pre-signed PCM/float WAV objects and has no XML, DTD, ElementDeclHandler, or Expat path. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-4224 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.

Boundary: the headless worker never imports webbrowser or launches a browser/shell from a URL. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-4786 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.

Boundary: the worker does not decompress attacker data or reuse lzma, bz2, or gzip decompressor objects after MemoryError. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-6100 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.

Boundary: the worker has no XML or ElementTree input path, so an attacker cannot supply an Expat hash-flooding document. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-7210 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.

Boundary: the worker does not process bzip2 input or reuse BZ2Decompressor after an error. Evidence: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-9669 Reassess: at Python 3.12.14 or any Python package change.

Boundary: the Python worker launches no subprocesses and never invokes gzip over attacker-controlled LZW/LZH files. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-41992 Reassess: on any gzip or base-image change.

Boundary: the worker performs no pathname ACL operation and runs without privilege as UID/GID 10001, so an attacker cannot direct a privileged acl_*_file call. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-54369 Reassess: on any ACL or base-image change.

Boundary: the worker invokes no getfacl, setfacl, chacl, or privileged pathname ACL operation and runs as UID/GID 10001. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-54370 Reassess: on any ACL or base-image change.

Boundary: the worker never calls the deprecated resolver-debug functions, and CI inventories every final-image ELF before audit-tool installation, verifies it remains byte-identical, and fails on imports or non-provider symbol strings for ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, or fp_nquery. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-5435 Reassess: on any native dependency, audit, glibc, or base-image change.

Boundary: remote input cannot control a native format string, and CI inventories every byte-identical final-image ELF and scans narrow plus UTF-32LE/BE literals for %mc, %mC, or %mlc scanf formats whose explicit width exceeds 1024. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-5450 Reassess: on any native dependency, audit, glibc, or base-image change.

Boundary: the image locks and CI verifies LANG/LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, where the required single/multibyte encoding overlap is impossible; the protocol is JSON/UTF-8 plus binary WAV and has no ungetwc path. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-5928 Reassess: on any locale, native dependency, glibc, or base-image change.

Boundary: the flaw is confined to the infocmp CLI, while the worker launches no subprocess and exposes no terminal/terminfo input. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-69720 Reassess: on any ncurses or base-image change.

Boundary: the worker opens no SQLite database, accepts no SQL, and executes no FTS5 MATCH query over an attacker-controlled database. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-11822 Reassess: on any SQLite or base-image change.

Boundary: the worker opens no SQLite database, accepts no SQL, and executes no FTS5 MATCH query over an attacker-controlled database. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-11824 Reassess: on any SQLite or base-image change.

Boundary: both Debian libsndfile and SoundFile 0.13.1's bundled libsndfile 1.2.2 are present, but the worker's bounded RIFF parser rejects IMA ADPCM (format 0x0011) and every codec except PCM/float before passing only tensors to the model; tests pin this rejection. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-37555 Reassess: on any WAV parser, SoundFile, libsndfile, model-adapter, or base-image change.

Boundary: although Perl Socket is present, the Python worker never invokes Perl or passes attacker-controlled values to pack_ip_mreq_source. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-12087 Reassess: on any Perl, process-launch, or base-image change.

Boundary: the Python worker never invokes Perl or compiles an attacker-controlled Perl regular expression. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-13221 Reassess: on any Perl, process-launch, or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship Archive::Tar, and the worker does not invoke Perl or extract archives. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship Archive::Tar, and the worker does not invoke Perl or extract archives. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship IO::Uncompress::Unzip, and the worker does not invoke Perl or inspect ZIP entries. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship the zipdetails CLI, and the worker launches no subprocess or ZIP tooling. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship File::GlobMapper/IO::Compress, and the worker never invokes Perl with an output glob. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.

Boundary: the Python worker never invokes Perl or supplies an attacker-controlled pack/unpack template. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-57432 Reassess: on any Perl, process-launch, or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship Storable, and the worker never invokes Perl to deserialize a blob. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship HTTP::Tiny, and worker HTTP is implemented in Python/httpx with redirect restrictions. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.

Boundary: the overflow is limited to 32-bit Perl builds, while the image and release validator require linux/amd64; the worker also never invokes Perl. Evidence: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-8376 Reassess: on any platform, Perl, or base-image change.

Boundary: Debian perl-base does not ship Archive::Tar, and the worker does not invoke Perl or extract archives. Evidence: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/perl-base/filelist Reassess: on any Perl package or base-image change.
